problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: size 40 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Every shipment must be placed on exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity limit.
